description: This file defines the DetailedTimesheet class in the OrangeHRM system, representing a data transfer object that encapsulates detailed information about a timesheet, including its associated timesheet entity, rows, and columns.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheet
classes.description: A data transfer object for detailed timesheet information, holding a Timesheet entity along with arrays of rows and columns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DetailedTimesheet with a Timesheet object, and arrays of rows and columns.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns the array of timesheet rows.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of timesheet columns.
